messages:
hazel: quick postmortem follow-up: yesterday's cross-region flip produced a brief TLS mismatch + client retry amplification. creating action items.
omar: can we paste the short timeline snippet?
hazel: ```
2026-03-25T19:02:11Z lb flip start -> us-east -> eu-north
2026-03-25T19:02:12Z backend-eun sidecar reported old cert CN
2026-03-25T19:02:13Z clients retried -> spike in 502/504 for ~45s
```
nina: initial triage: cert propagation lag + flip script with no cooldown + aggressive edge retry knob. also saw healthcheck TTL mismatch for the new target group.
omar: proposed quick mitigations: 1) add 8s cooldown after route-change 2) set max client retries to 3 with jitter 3) make healthcheck timeout tolerant (5s -> 12s) during transition
hazel: owners + ETAs recorded below and in the PM doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2026-03-25-lb-dns-retry
- omar: flip-script cooldown + small e2e test  ETA 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC
- nina: edge retry cap + canary rollout  ETA 2026-03-26 12:00 UTC
- hazel: postmortem doc update + incident-pattern review  ETA 2026-03-28 09:00 PT
ops-bot: created runbook stub: https://docs.internal/runbooks/lb-flip-tls-check
infra-oncall: prefer low-traffic window 02:00-04:00 UTC for the flip change. will monitor and escalate if TLS errors > 0.4% for 5m
omar: opened PR for cooldown + healthcheck tolerance: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/524
nina: will add feature-flag to toggle retry cap for quick rollback if needed. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/edge/pulls/347
deploy-bot: scheduling maintenance window 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z
hazel: pattern note: similar short spikes occurred on 2026-01-09 and 2026-02-14 during automated flips. adding 90-day pattern review task.
omar: doing packet captures now to verify SNI headers during flip, will paste summary when done.
ops-bot: alert created: tls.handshake.fail.rate > 0.3% for 5m
infra-oncall: will coordinate canary and notify pager 15m before apply. :bell:
hazel: please update this thread when your task is complete. follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-29 09:00 PT. thanks all!
